meta.name: eureka
meta.description: Capture technical breakthroughs and transform them into actionable, reusable documentation. Use this skill when the user has achieved a significant technical insight, solved a hard problem, discovered a non-obvious solution, or wants to document a breakthrough moment. Also trigger when the user mentions "eureka", "breakthrough", "document this insight", "capture this discovery", or wants to turn a technical win into reusable knowledge.

copy.tagline: 把技术突破转化为可复用的文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常解决难题后想记录下关键洞察
